description: Source code for ShareViewController class handling media and text sharing extensions in an iOS app, including file handling, media processing, and communication with host app.

classes.name: ShareViewController
classes.description: A view controller managing sharing of media and text content from extension context, processing attachments, and communicating with host app.

classes.name: SharedMediaFile
classes.description: A data model representing shared media files, including path, thumbnail, duration, and type.

methods.name: runSelectPost
methods.description: Processes extension input items and attachments, delegating handling based on content type.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description: Loads and processes text data from attachment, saving to shared preferences and redirecting.

methods.name: handleUrl
methods.description: Loads URL data from attachment, converting to string, saving, and redirecting.

methods.name: handleImages
methods.description: Processes image attachments, copies files, and updates shared media list.

methods.name: handleVideos
methods.description: Processes video attachments, extracts thumbnails and duration, and updates shared media list.

methods.name: handleFiles
methods.description: Processes file URL attachments, copies files, and updates shared media list.

methods.name: dismissWithError
methods.description: Displays error alert and completes extension request.

methods.name: redirectToHostApp
methods.description: Constructs URL and performs openURL action to redirect to host app.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Determines file extension based on URL and media type.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Generates filename from URL, with fallback to UUID.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copies file from source URL to destination URL, handling errors.

methods.name: getSharedMediaFile
methods.description: Creates SharedMediaFile object for video, generating thumbnail and duration.

methods.name: getThumbnailPath
methods.description: Generates thumbnail file path for a video URL.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Encodes array of SharedMediaFile to Data using JSONEncoder.
